links.outcome: Proportion of residents using LLMs who had received formal LLM education or training
links.effect: 94.4% reported not having received education or training on LLM use; 83.3% used LLMs for any purpose and 37.1% had concerns about using them for learning.
links.quote: Of respondents, 94.4% reported not having received education or training on the use of LLMs, and 37.1% reported concerns with the use of the technology for plastic surgery learning.

screen.reason: The study is a survey examining the real-world adoption, use cases, and perceptions of LLMs among Canadian plastic surgery residents.
